name: awe
quote: The night sky makes me feel so small.
description: A vivid sensation that challenges your inner model of the world in a humbling or even slighty frightening way.

variations.name: existential awe
variations.description: The sense of majesty and terror that comes from perceiving a thread of the fabric of existence.

variations.name: awe of nature
variations.description: A humbling sense of wonder about nature's power, scale, beauty, and destructiveness.

variations.name: social awe
variations.description: A humbling sense of amazement about someone expertly displaying a valued skill or social characteristic.

commentaries.quote: Awe is underrated. Go find some.
A self-centered world has no awe.

conditions: A perception that challenges your inner model of the world in a humbling or slightly frightening way.
